name: HEAD TRAMPOLINE
blurb: Air heavy bounces them 80 px and refunds a jump. Kill on the bounce is always blunt.

name: FAMILY DISCOUNT
blurb: Your hits refill the partner's Steam. Shared combo lives if only one of you eats dirt.

name: OFFICE RAGE
blurb: Lights apply Staple bleed. Staple-kills explode paper. Lights still flash red until then.

name: QUIET LUNCH
blurb: SNAP on a back restores 8 HP. Missed SNAP is your problem.

name: DOUBLE SLAP
blurb: A Parenting Slap heals both 20% and they hit meaner for 2 seconds. Will be abused.

name: RICOCHET POLICY
blurb: Batwings bounce +1 off metal. Neon that is hit is a conversation.

name: TUTORING
blurb: Every 8th light without eating dirt: the next shot fires twice. Homework.

name: PENDULUM POLITICS
blurb: A web-slam kill leaves a lamp. The Son can grab it. Solo: you still get the lamp.

name: COP OUT
blurb: SNAP on a cop refunds one Wanted stamp. The paperwork files itself.

name: STEAM TAX
blurb: Lights cost 0 Steam. Heavies refund 8. The clinic calls it a loophole.

name: FAMILY BLITZ
blurb: Dash i-frames +4. Slide hits twice. SoR4 called; it wants its meter back.
